title: ZNF263-NuRD-mediated repression of STAT1 curtails MHC-I antigen presentation and IFN-gamma efficacy in prostate cancer.
authors: Guan, Han; Mao, Likai; Fang, Fang; Wu, Tiange; Cheng, Yifei; You, Zonghao; Lin, Hao; Zhang, Ruixin; Zhuang, Junyong; Teng, Gao-Jun; Shu, Chuanjun; Ju, Shenghong; Chen, Ming; Li, Wenchao; Xu, Bin
journal: Proceedings of the National Academy of Sciences of the United States of America
one_liner_zh: 该文研究ZNF263转录抑制因子通过招募NuRD复合物抑制STAT1启动子从而下调MHC-I表达，涉及TF-DNA结合与转录调控机制，但核心是肿瘤免疫与表观遗传调控，方法以实验为主，仅含少量分子对接，与TF-DNA互作建模课题关联度中等。
abstract: Loss of major histocompatibility complex (MHC)-I is a hallmark of prostate cancer (PCa) immune evasion and immunotherapy failure. Here, we identify ZNF263 as a transcriptional repressor that silences MHC-I by recruiting nucleosome-remodeling and deacetylase (NuRD) to the STAT1 promoter, reducing STAT1 and MHC-I expression. Hypoxia enhances this repression through two ZNF263 modifications: phosphorylation-driven phase separation that strengthens NuRD interaction and O-GlcNAcylation at S662 that aids STAT1 promoter binding. O-GlcNAcylation also promotes interaction with protein kinase, DNA‑activated catalytic subunit (PRKDC), amplifying phosphorylation. Interferon‑gamma (IFN‑gamma)‑induced MHC-I induction is augmented upon ZNF263 loss. In silico docking identified Viroptic as a Kruppel‑associated box (KRAB) pocket binder disrupting ZNF263-NuRD, derepressing STAT1, and potentiating IFN-gamma antitumor immunity in vivo. High ZNF263 correlates with low MHC-I, scarce CD8+ T cells, and poor survival, providing rationale for targeting ZNF263 in PCa immunotherapy.
abstract_zh: 主要组织相容性复合体（MHC）-I的缺失是前列腺癌（PCa）免疫逃逸和免疫治疗失败的一个标志。在此，我们确定ZNF263为一种转录抑制因子，通过招募核小体重塑和去乙酰化酶（NuRD）至STAT1启动子，沉默MHC-I，从而降低STAT1和MHC-I的表达。缺氧通过两种ZNF263修饰增强这种抑制：磷酸化驱动的相分离（phase separation）加强NuRD相互作用，以及S662位点的O-GlcNAc糖基化有助于STAT1启动子结合。O-GlcNAc糖基化还促进与蛋白激酶、DNA激活催化亚基（PRKDC）的相互作用，放大磷酸化。干扰素-γ（IFN-γ）诱导的MHC-I表达在ZNF263缺失时增强。计算机模拟对接鉴定出Viroptic为Kruppel相关盒（KRAB）口袋结合剂，破坏ZNF263-NuRD相互作用，解除STAT1抑制，并在体内增强IFN-γ抗肿瘤免疫。高ZNF263水平与低MHC-I、稀疏CD8+ T细胞及不良生存率相关，为靶向ZNF263用于PCa免疫治疗提供了理论依据。
